intro.text: Oroden is an Alethi toddler, the youngest child of Lirin and Hesina and Kaladin's baby brother.

items.text: Oroden was born in Hearthstone in late 1172 or early 1173, around three years after his older brothers Kaladin and Tien left to serve in the Alethi armies. His name means 'child of peace'.

His parents believed Kaladin dead when Oroden was born. When Kaladin returned home in early 1175, he was shocked to find he had a baby brother, and wept on meeting him. Soon after, Oroden sheltered in Roshone's manor with the rest of the town when the Everstorm struck.

Oroden stayed in Hearthstone while singer forces occupied it, until the town was evacuated to Urithiru. There he lived with his parents on the sixth floor, grew closer to Kaladin, and was entertained by Syl, who shapeshifted into animals for him.
When Odium's forces took Urithiru, Oroden and his parents were held in their clinic under guard. Rlain was assigned there and quickly grew close to the family, including Oroden.
When Moash came to the clinic to set a trap for Kaladin, he had Oroden and his parents bound and gagged. Oroden and Hesina remained in the infirmary through a skirmish between rival singers.
On the morning Kaladin left for Shinovar, Oroden played blocks with him and Syl and tried to comfort his older brother before Kaladin hugged him goodbye.

personality.text: Oroden seems a happy child who takes quickly to both Kaladin and Rlain and enjoys playing with toys.
